# Archived Zebra fixture

`zebra-mainnet-1.json` is the JSON body of this unmodified upstream snapshot:

[ZcashFoundation/zebra, get_block_verbose_height_verbosity_2@mainnet_10.snap](https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/blob/6ef54e34361156d6344157ba3d8935dcf8ffdbff/zebra-rpc/src/methods/tests/snapshots/get_block_verbose_height_verbosity_2%40mainnet_10.snap)

Revision: `6ef54e34361156d6344157ba3d8935dcf8ffdbff`.
Retrieved 16 October 2026. The snapshot metadata header was removed; the JSON body
was retained. It describes mainnet block 1 and its coinbase transaction at a
historical test tip. This is an archived public-chain fixture, not a live-node
probe or a contemporary shielded-payment example. It checks historical RPC shape,
exact output values, and handling of a bare public-key script with no address.
Modern Sapling, Orchard, and Ironwood accounting tests use synthetic RPC data.

JSON body SHA-256: `147460f97fee3b74c3db6339a28df0c321ac7d433c2b5d1f7b0ad7b0e3b0eef9`.
